title: "rungar runners rm"
description: "Remove runners, the safe way round"
---

Remove runners, the safe way round: each one's registration first, which GitHub refuses for a runner running a job, and only then its machine. A runner running a job is left to finish, and said so. A scale set whose runner is removed creates another if it needs one. A runner of a configured scale set with no machine on the fleet, disconnected from GitHub, has its registration removed.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar runners rm NAME...
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
